endorsements.name: Adam Bromiley
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-24522
endorsements.description: KUNBUS Revolution Pi OS Bookworm 01/2025 is vulnerable because authentication is not configured by default for the Node-RED server. This can give an unauthenticated remote attacker full access to the Node-RED server where they can run arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 10)

endorsements.name: Adam Bromiley
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-35996
endorsements.description: KUNBUS PiCtory version 2.11.1 and earlier are vulnerable when an authenticated remote attacker crafts a special filename that can be stored by API endpoints. That filename is later transmitted to the client in order to show a list of configuration files. Due to a missing escape or sanitization, the filename could be executed as HTML script tag resulting in a cross-site-scripting attack.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9)

endorsements.name: Adam Bromiley
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-36558
endorsements.description: KUNBUS PiCtory version 2.11.1 and earlier are vulnerable to a cross-site-scripting attack via the sso_token used for authentication. If an attacker provides the user with a PiCtory URL containing an HTML script as an sso_token, that script will reply to the user and be executed.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)
